description: Three-panel schematic (no micrographs and no plotted data points) showing the time evolution of the Mn concentration profile across a moving α/γ interface during intercritical annealing (IAT) of a medium-Mn steel. All three panels share identical axes: vertical "Mn (wt. %)" and horizontal "Distance (z)" with origin 0 marked at the left; a yellow-shaded band at the left denotes austenite (γ) and the unshaded field at the right is labelled α/δ. The γ band is narrowest in (a) and widest in (c), i.e. the interface migrates towards α. (a) t = 0, labelled "700 °C (t=0)": two flat horizontal lines, C_Mn^γ inside γ (higher level) and C_Mn^α/δ in α/δ (lower level), with no gradients. (b) t = t₁, "700 °C (t=t₁)": solid curved profiles develop — on the γ side Mn falls from C_Mn^γ(eq) at the interface to C_Mn^γ in the far field, on the α/δ side it rises from C_Mn^α/δ(eq) at the interface towards C_Mn^α/δ far away; four dashed horizontals mark these levels. (c) t = ∞, "700 °C (t=∞)": flat steps at C_Mn^γ(eq) and C_Mn^α/δ(eq), no gradient. The figure argues that local-equilibrium partitioning rejects Mn from α into γ, creating transient gradients that persist because the 1 h anneal is finite.

observations.observation: All three panels use the same axes: vertical axis labelled 'Mn (wt. %)' and horizontal axis labelled 'Distance (z)' with the origin marked '0' at the left end.
The yellow-shaded band at the left of every panel is labelled γ and the unshaded field at the right is labelled α/δ; no numeric values are printed on either axis.

Panel (a) carries the annotation '700 °C (t=0)' and shows two flat horizontal lines only — C_Mn^γ in γ at a higher level and C_Mn^α/δ in α/δ at a lower level — i.e. a step profile with no concentration gradients.

Panel (b) is annotated '700 °C (t=t₁)' and contains two solid curved profiles: on the γ side Mn decays from C_Mn^γ(eq) at the interface down to C_Mn^γ in the interior, and on the α/δ side it rises from C_Mn^α/δ(eq) at the interface towards C_Mn^α/δ in the far field.
Panel (b) is the only panel carrying four dashed horizontal reference lines, labelled C_Mn^γ(eq), C_Mn^γ (left side) and C_Mn^α/δ, C_Mn^α/δ(eq) (right side).
Panel (c) is annotated '700 °C (t=∞)' and shows gradient-free flat steps at C_Mn^γ(eq) in γ and C_Mn^α/δ(eq) in α/δ, the highest Mn level appearing in the γ phase.
The width of the shaded γ region increases in the order (a) < (b) < (c), showing the α/γ interface migrating towards the α phase (austenite thickening) with annealing time.
The caption states that the shaded region in these concentration profiles represents the fraction of γ (austenite).
The caption states that panel (c) represents the final condition t = ∞, assuming equilibrium is achieved at the intercritical annealing temperature.

The citing text states that at t = 0 the Mn concentration is the same as observed in the HR (hot-rolled) samples and is expected to be lower than the equilibrium Mn concentration of austenite at the IAT.

The citing text states that the interface concentrations change to establish local equilibrium, producing concentration gradients within α and γ whose magnitude depends on the initial far-field concentrations (C_Mn^γ and C_Mn^α/δ of the hot-rolled samples) and on the equilibrium concentrations C_Mn^γ(eq) and C_Mn^α/δ(eq) at the IAT.

The citing text states that the gradients diminish as the interface moves towards the α phase, but because the annealing time is only 1 h some parts of γ remain locally enriched in Mn above the equilibrium concentration, as shown by Yu et al. [30].

subfigures.description: Schematic Mn (wt.%) vs Distance (z) profile at t = 0 (700 °C, just brought to IAT): narrow yellow-shaded γ band at left, α/δ field at right, no gradients. Two flat horizontal lines at different heights labelled C_Mn^γ (in γ, higher) and C_Mn^α/δ (in α/δ, lower).

Schematic profile at t = t₁ (700 °C): solid curved lines show Mn decreasing from C_Mn^γ(eq) at the interface to C_Mn^γ far inside γ, and increasing from C_Mn^α/δ(eq) at the interface to C_Mn^α/δ far inside α/δ. Dashed horizontals mark C_Mn^γ(eq), C_Mn^γ, C_Mn^α/δ and C_Mn^α/δ(eq); the γ band is wider than in (a) and the interface has moved towards α.
Schematic profile at t = ∞ (700 °C, equilibrium assumed): no gradients — flat steps at C_Mn^γ(eq) in γ and C_Mn^α/δ(eq) in α/δ, with the widest yellow γ band and the interface furthest to the right.

unreadable_items: No numeric Mn concentration values are printed on the 'Mn (wt. %)' axis, so absolute C_Mn^γ, C_Mn^α/δ, C_Mn^γ(eq) and C_Mn^α/δ(eq) values cannot be read from the figure
No numeric distance scale is printed on the 'Distance (z)' axis; interface positions are only relative
